title: Optional roadmap status tool
goal: A template tool for projects that keep `docs/ROADMAP.md`, enabled by a setting
acceptance: `core/tools/roadmap-status.mjs` generates milestone status from the records and `--check` fails when `docs/ROADMAP.md` is stale; enabled by `roadmap.enabled` in `.harness.json`, absent means off and the tool is not copied into the check list
Fixtures: all steps closed, one open, a milestone naming an unknown record, roadmap file missing under `enabled`
Failing test committed first: the stale-roadmap fixture expects `--check` to fail against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h (a copy) plus the template packaging, the setting and failing-first fixtures. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
